title: Radio Interview (David): Punctual Cut, Rate to Stay at Current Level Going Forward
summary: In a second post-decision interview, Governor Rodríguez again calls the 25bp cut to 6.25% a 'punctual adjustment of the monetary stance', but here she spells out the guidance that limits its dovishness: given external challenges and the 'last effort' needed to bring inflation to target, it will be appropriate to keep the rate at its current level going forward, a stance she says remains conducive to lower inflation. The rationale matches the other interview (core trending down since the start of the year with services ex-housing/education easing on slack, a headline uptick from non-core base effects, contained energy inflation thanks to fuel-price stabilization, limited FX pass-through when the economy has idle capacity, restriction still operating), plus a forecast in which headline rises in Q4 2026 slightly more than previously expected before falling from Q1 2027 to the 3% target within 2027, with projections essentially unchanged. On the peso she repeats that it depreciated since September but traded in an orderly way, remains below its 2025 average, and that Mexico and the US are at different points of the cycle. Versus the August interview (hold at 6.50%, 'no victory declared'), she has moved to easing, but this text pairs the cut with an explicit pause and a 'message of caution', so it reads less dovish than the Alicia Salgado interview.

key_quotes.quote: será apropiado mantener la tasa en su nivel vigente hacia adelante, por lo que dicha postura continúa siendo conducente a una reducción de la inflación
key_quotes.context: Explicit forward guidance: pause after the cut.

key_quotes.quote: si bien no deja de estar acompañada de un mensaje de cautela, ya que, ante los retos que prevalecen en el entorno externo y el último esfuerzo necesario para llevar la inflación a su meta
key_quotes.context: Caution attached to the cut; last mile of disinflation.

key_quotes.quote: Cuando la economía opera con capacidad ociosa, como es el caso, el traspaso cambiario tiende a ser menor.
key_quotes.context: Slack as the reason FX pass-through is limited despite depreciation.

key_quotes.quote: Asimismo, está incorporando la postura monetaria restrictiva implementada a lo largo de 3 años, y que nuestra postura actual siga contribuyendo a mitigar las presiones inflacionarias en la inflación subyacente.
key_quotes.context: Current stance still read as restrictive after the cut.
